status: Phase-0 pure quote/budget contract; gameplay settlement is phase 1

tariff.reference: MarketState.get_price(good_id), including current market impact/carbon, before buy markup
tariff.precision: Existing float ledger; aggregate canonical sorted quantities, do not round money per good/call. Round for UI only; compare accounting within existing tolerances.

prototype.eligibility: Prototype explicitly authored Pepper Valley service; reject missing good/class/location/price rules without fallback. Special orders, player switching and building credit tabs deferred.

sources: explicit standard loan within available capacity
funding.admission: one complete feasible scaled recipe batch or zero; never partial purchases
priority: settle arrived commitments and construction claims
reserve remaining due obligations and outstanding unpaid purchases once
stable building creation order, instance ID tie break
reserve accepted batch inputs, input fee, labour, maintenance and predicted grid expense
funding.new_loan_timing: Use LoanState.take_loan before acquisition. Existing standard interest/grace/payment schedule and once-per-turn payment tick apply as for a loan taken in DECIDE; no extra grace or immediate nonstandard payment. Revalidate before draw; funding is not operating revenue.
funding.building_tabs: Explicitly reject in initial opt-in prototype; no simultaneous synthetic tab refund. Integrate later before onboarding uses tabs.
funding.commitments: Pass residual obligations, not already paid arrivals/construction; reserve outstanding unpaid purchases as existing headroom does. Do not include speculative future sales.

holdings.owner: player, private to immutable building instance and originating operation
holdings.scope: one unfinished recipe cycle; no shared tile warehouse; power remains existing system
holdings.preflight_failure: no purchase, fee, volume or loan
holdings.post_acquisition_failure: retain actual paid goods and receipt; no automatic refund, second fee or duplicate buy
holdings.retry: reuse building-private inputs and buy only complete affordable shortfall
holdings.recipe_change: block change while holdings exist until player explicitly releases to owned stock or performs an ordinary priced sale; no free refund
holdings.disabled: holdings persist, no new purchase; no repeated service charge for existing operating holding
holdings.removal: block final removal until paid holdings/output disposition is explicit; never delete assets
holdings.output_failure: retain at most one produced cycle privately; block further production until settled/released; no speculative accumulation

identity.operation: JSON tuple [persistent match ID, resolution turn, immutable building instance ID]
identity.recipe_revision: snapshotted payload, not new operation identity: changing it cannot enable a second cycle
identity.replay: same ID and payload returns prior settlement; conflicting payload rejects; quote refresh has no mutation

negative_net_sale: Do not commit a negative-net auto-sale or silently dispose; retain bounded output and expose blocked reason. Future explicit disposal requires funding.

process: advance physical arrivals once; settle and claim construction
snapshot eligible building policies/prices and feasibility
admit complete batches; reserve obligations; explicitly draw permitted funding
acquire into building-private holdings and record each purchase/fee/volume once
existing bounded production/power cascade, each building at most once
settle actual building output and output fee; dispatch new physical movements without advance
expenses and existing loan/tab/tax/report sequence; one inclusive fee total
phases.direct_mode: preserve old replenishment for direct buildings only; provider holdings never enter shared same-turn direct-feed pools

save.planned_owner: MatchState serialized service state through existing SaveLoad path; no new competing shipment store
save.missing_payload: legacy/no active provider service, including old middleman_v1 port-only saves; flag alone does not auto-enable buildings
save.legacy_defaults: missing logistics_model means legacy, no migration of stocks/shipments/warehouse entitlements
save.new_provider_game: explicit service schema and building modes; persist price/tariff IDs, input/output holdings and settlement IDs
save.migration_gate: Phase1 adds default/import/export and version handling once actual serialized fields exist

cash_invariant: opening + goods receipts + financing - purchases - service fees - operating costs - finance outflows = closing
goods_invariant: opening + acquisitions + production = consumption + explicit disposal + closing across private holdings, owned stock and transit
